item.title: Sedalia Man Booked on Probation Violation.
item.description: A Sedalia man who was convicted in Livingston County in 2023 for Possession of a controlled substance was arrested in Callaway County on a Probation violation warrant. Thirty-eight-year-old Kevin Henry Lee is awaiting extradition to Livingston County and is held with bond set at $20,000 cash only.
